translation_notes.47-cn: Render 국수전 (國手戰) as 国手战, adding 韩国 to distinguish this historical Korean title from the Taiwanese Guoshou and other national events.
translation_notes.47-tw: Render 국수전 as 國手戰 in Traditional Chinese, preserving explicit 韓國 country scope.
translation_notes.47-jp: Render 국수전 as 国手戦 in Japanese and add 韓国 to distinguish the Korean competition.
translation_notes.63-cn: Render 関西棋院第一位決定戦 in Simplified Chinese as 关西棋院第一位决定战 and add 日本 country context; preserve first-place decision tournament scope.
translation_notes.63-tw: Render 関西棋院第一位決定戦 as 關西棋院第一位決定戰 in Traditional Chinese, adding 日本 country context.
translation_notes.63-ko: Render 関西棋院 as 간사이기원 and 第一位決定戦 as 제1위 결정전. Preserve the Kansai Ki-in competition rather than the Nihon Ki-in or All-Japan first-place events.
translation_notes.63-en: Retain the institution's name Kansai Ki-in and translate 第一位決定戦 as First Place Tournament. This explicit translation does not claim published use or the broader Kansai Ki-in Championship identity.
translation_notes.67-ko: Render 春兰杯世界职业围棋锦标赛 as 춘란배 세계프로바둑선수권대회, preserving sponsor, world, professional, Go and championship scope.
translation_notes.56-cn: Convert 中環碁聖賽 into Simplified Chinese 中环碁圣赛; retain 碁 as part of this proper title. This is the newly numbered event from 2013.
translation_notes.56-jp: Render 中環碁聖賽 as 中環碁聖戦 in Japanese, adding 台湾 to distinguish it from Japanese Gosei and from the former international CMC Cup.
translation_notes.97-tw: Render the official domestic 衢州烂柯杯中国围棋冠军赛 in Traditional Chinese as 衢州爛柯盃中國圍棋冠軍賽; keep 中國 and 冠軍賽 to distinguish the later world Lanke event.
translation_notes.97-jp: Render the domestic Chinese championship as 衢州爛柯杯中国囲碁チャンピオン戦. Preserve the title's Chinese championship scope without introducing a world championship claim.
translation_notes.97-ko: Render the domestic championship as 취저우 란커배 중국바둑선수권대회, retaining Quzhou/Lanke and Chinese Go championship scope; this is not the world Lanke Cup.
translation_notes.97-en: Render 衢州烂柯杯中国围棋冠军赛 as Quzhou Lanke Cup Chinese Go Championship. Chinese Go Championship explicitly distinguishes this domestic event from the World Go Open launched in 2023.
